Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
I think I was to have 6 copies of the [Prince and Page](../books.html#61) sent to myself - also in the same parcel one of the [Heir of Redclyffe](../books.html#15). I have seen nothing of them so perhaps they have been forgotten or come to some mischance by the way.

With all new years greetings

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Endorsed ‘Rail January 3rd’.
